svg.title: NorthStar — Navigating chemical space
svg.desc: A high-level research workflow: biochemical and structural knowledge represented through SMILES and physicochemical properties; a conditional variational autoencoder learns a latent chemical landscape; Remdesivir supplies a reference property profile to guide generation of structurally diverse candidates; molecular docking and consensus pharmacophores support lead prioritization. Molecular and binding-site graphics are schematic.
svg.text: From two-dimensional molecular information to new candidates in three-dimensional target space.
Use a known drug as a compass to explore new molecular possibilities.
Molecular, latent-space and binding-site illustrations are schematic.
